items.title: A PayPal sale is back on the table: What we know about Stripe, Advent's bid
items.summary: Stripe (STRI.PVT) and Advent are reportedly in talks to acquire PayPal (PYPL), according to the Wall Street Journal. Yahoo Finance's Josh Lipton outlines what we know so far.

items.title: PayPal (PYPL) Is In Acquisition Talks At $53 Billion
items.summary: PayPal Holdings (NasdaqGS: PYPL) is in active talks over a potential acquisition by Stripe and Advent International, following an earlier offer that PayPal rejected. The proposed deal would bring together a major listed digital payments company and a large private fintech group, alongside a global private equity investor. items.title: Talks to sell PayPal to Stripe and Advent are heating up
items.summary: PayPal is still reportedly negotiating a potential sale to Stripe and private equity firm Advent, as the fintech firm's new CEO attempts to turn the company around.

items.title: PayPal Stock Rises on Report of Stripe, Advent Buyout Talks
items.summary: PayPal  stock rose on Friday after a report said that the payments company is in negotiations to sell itself to Stripe and private-equity firm Advent International, with the potential buyers discussing a higher price than their previous offer.  Stripe and Advent offered $60.50 a share for PayPal in a July deal that would value the fintech company at around $53 billion, but PayPal considered the bid too low, the Wall Street Journal reported on Friday, citing people familiar with the matter.  PayPal declined to comment.

items.title: PYPL Stock Rises After Report Says Stripe And Advent May Be Ready To Raise Their PayPal Bid
items.summary: Stripe and Advent have reportedly been negotiating with PayPal after the payments company rejected their $60.50-a-share proposal in July as too low.

items.title: Stripe and Advent bid $60.50 a share for PayPal as talks advance, WSJ reports
items.summary: PayPal (NASDAQ: PYPL) shares are trading up approximately 1.7% on the news as of Friday afternoon, extending a remarkable run that saw the stock surge 32.5% in July alone — making it the third-best performer in the S&P 500 that month — largely on earlier takeover speculation.

items.title: PayPal in Talks to Sell Itself to Stripe, Private-Equity Firm Advent
items.summary: The fintech startup and private-equity firm Advent offered to buy the struggling payments company in July.
